?Court No. - 72
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 5414 of 2020
Applicant :- Surjeet Singh Suman And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Lavkush Kumar Bhatt
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Suvarna Singh,Upendra Singh Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and perused the record.
Surjeet Singh, applicant no.1 and Smt. Shobha Sagar, the wife of applicant no.1/ opposite party no.2 are present in person alongwith their six year old daughter Ridhi Suman.

By moving this application, the prayer is made to quash the charge-sheet dated 30.11.2017,
cognizance order dated 03.02.2018 as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.148 of 2018 (State Vs. Surjeet Singh and others) arising out of Case Crime No.0039 of 2017, under Sections 498-A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Farrukhabad, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Sadar, Farrukhabad.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicants that the parties have arrived a compromise and in continuation of their compromise the parties put to an end the case under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
and the case under 9 of Hindu Marriage Act.

sentences.text: When the opposite party no.2 present in the Court was asked about the compromise, she stated that on the assurance of the applicant no.1 that he will keep her happily she had entered into compromise and as a condition precedent of the assurance given by her husband she withdrew her two cases under Section 125 Cr.P.C. and also gave her consent to withdraw the present case under Sections 498A, 323, 506 IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act.

Denying the version of the counsel for the applicants, opposite party no.2 stated in the Court that she was mentally and physically harassed at her matrimonial house by her husband, both the brothers-in-law, mother-in-law and father-in-law.
The husband used to say that he did not like her as she was ugly.
He would marry with his colleague who is a teacher in the same college and would live with her.
Her brother-in-law Vikram Singh is a drunkard person.
He has also divorced her wife.
He used to assault her with the thing whatever used to come in his hands in inebriated position.

At last, due to harassment at the hands of her in-laws, she left her matrimonial house alongwith her minor daughter and now she has bluntly denied to live with her husband and has stated that her husband does not want to get her treated as one of her kidney has been completely destroyed and the other kidney is also not healthy.
While the husband/ applicant no.1 present in the court denied all the allegations and stated that opposite party no.2 is a lady of suspicious nature.
He has no extramarital relations.
Opposite party no.2 herself does not want to live with him.

He showed the documents dated 04.02.2023,
06.02.2023, 08.02.2023, 09.02.2023, 17.02.2023 and 05.03.2023 regarding treatment of his wife by doctor Pranjal Pankaj, Kanpur.
He has stated that his wife is being treated by a competent doctor at his expenses.
If we go through these documents these are from 4th February, 2023 to 5th March, 2023, while opposite party no.2 claims herself to be suffering from various ailments since long.
The opposite party no.2 is not ready to go with her husband applicant no.1 on the ground of atrocities committed by her husband and the members of her matrimonial family.
As per impugned FIR, there is allegation against the applicants alongwith other co-accused persons to demand extra dowry and harassing the opposite party no.2 mentally and physically both.
There is allegation of giving threat of life and to solemnize second marriage by applicant no.1.
It is said that applicant no.1 neither gives her his salary, nor discloses her the place of his service.
He is not was ready to keep her with him.

Opposite party no.2 is highly educated lady, who has passed M.Com,
B.Ed and TET, but she was turned out of her matrimonial house at the time of her seven month pregnancy on 23.02.2017.
She gave birth to a female child.

After that by panchayat, she is living with her in-laws, but since marriage all the named accused persons are harassing her giving threat of life,
if she does not signed the divorce papers.
The applicant no.1 wants to solemnize second marriage and he used to thrash her in front of her mother-in-law.
Her mother-in-law also used to thrash her with sleepers and now it is not safe for her to live in her in-laws house.
She has danger of her life and thus, prayer is made to take steps against the named accused persons.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants denied all the allegations but opposite party no.2 in the open Court made the above statements describing the atrocities committed by the applicants and other co-accused persons on her in her matrimonial house and denied to live further with her in-laws including husband.

The record shows that the opposite party no.2 was living separate from her husband, after panchayat she went to live alongwith her in-laws and husband again and on their assurance she withdrew her two cases under Section 125 Cr.P.C. and also signed a compromise in the present case under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

The signed compromise deed of the parties is appended at page-47 of the paper book, but after describing the atrocities by her in-laws including her husband, the opposite party no.2 has refused to pursue this compromise signed by her.
According to her, her husband has denied for her further treatment.

Signing the compromise in the present case under section 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act shows the genuineness of opposite party no.2 that she was ready to live with her husband but her husband after the opposite party no.2 signed the compromise in the present case and withdrew, her cases under sections 125 Cr.P.C. compelled her wife to leave her matrimonial house.
After going through the above facts, this Court does not find any good ground to quash the charge-sheet, cognizance order and the entire proceedings of abovementioned case.
The application being devoid of merit and is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Radhika  Surjeet Singh Suman And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62343902/
